description.zh: 座席号；说明：根据座席工号查询指定座席的预览外呼统计支持按照多个座席工号进行查询，多个座席工号之间使用英文逗号","分隔，默认查询账户下所有座席的预览外呼统计
description.en: The agent ID. You can query preview dialing statistics for one or more agents. To specify multiple agent IDs, separate them with a comma (,). If you leave this parameter empty, the operation returns statistics for all agents in your account.

description.zh: 统计时段结束时间；取值：0~23,默认值为24时
description.en: The end hour of the time range. Valid values: 0 to 23. The default value is 24.

description.zh: 说明：统计日期的结束时间，格式：yyyy-MM-dd
description.en: The end date in the yyyy-MM-dd format.

description.zh: 查询条数；取值：最大不能超过1000，默认10
description.en: The number of entries to return on each page. The maximum value is 1,000. The default value is 10.

description.zh: 查询起始位置；取值：大于等于0，默认0
description.en: The pagination offset. The value must be 0 or greater. The default is 0.

description.zh: 统计时段开始时间；取值：0~23,默认值为0时
description.en: The start hour of the time range. Valid values: 0 to 23. The default value is 0.

description.zh: 说明：统计日期的开始时间，格式：yyyy-MM-dd
description.en: The start date in the yyyy-MM-dd format.

description.zh: 统计方法；说明：0:分时1：分日2：汇总
description.en: The statistical method. Valid values: 0 (by hour), 1 (by day), and 2 (summary).

description.zh: 统计类型；说明：统计报表时间类型，1：日报表2：周报表3：月报表4：自定义时间
description.en: The time range type for the report. Valid values: 1 (daily report), 2 (weekly report), 3 (monthly report), and 4 (custom time).
